name: clonamic-git
description: Git commits, PRs, tags, and release notes under the user's own identity with no AI attribution trailers, footers, or bot authors.

interface.shortDescription: Commits, PRs, tags, and releases under your identity with no AI trace.
interface.longDescription: Write git commits, pull requests, tags, and release notes under the user's own identity with no AI co-author trailers, generated-with footers, or bot authors; scan and clean unpushed history with a backup branch; install a project-local commit-msg hook that strips AI trailers on every host.
defaultPrompt: Use Clonamic Git to commit these changes without any AI attribution.
